selection.verdict: NO VIABLE POINT. No stitch cell is both >= 1.25x faster end-to-end than the large model and more accurate than the small model at 95% confidence. The small model scores 88.6% and already runs 2.43x faster end-to-end than large. Best stitch accuracy was 85.7% [70.6%-93.7%] at L10->L10 (warm, 0.92x end-to-end). The small model dominates every point on both axes; running it directly is the better trade.
